description:
Generate PDF Document from a project. The endpoint returns url to PDF file.
See [Filtering on List Actions](https://developers.procore.com/documentation/filtering-on-list-actions) for information on using the filtering capabilities provided by this endpoint.

parameters.name: filters[permission_template]
parameters.description: Permission Template ID. Returns item(s) assiociated with the specified Permission Template ID.

parameters.name: filters[vendor_id]
parameters.description: Return item(s) with the specified Vendor IDs.

parameters.name: filters[id][]
parameters.description: Returns users matching the specified Login ID(s).

parameters.name: filters[except_id]
parameters.description: Excludes the user with the specified Login ID.

parameters.name: filters[trade_id][]
parameters.description: Returns users whose vendor record is associated with the specified trade id(s).

parameters.name: contact
parameters.description: Indicates whether contacts should be included in PDF document.

parameters.name: vendor
parameters.description: Indicates whether vendor should be included in PDF document.

parameters.name: user_role
parameters.description: Indicates whether user_role should be included in PDF document.

parameters.name: grouped_by_vendor
parameters.description: Indicates whether users should be grouped by vendor.

202.description: Accepted — the directory exceeds the synchronous size threshold (500 contacts). The PDF is being generated asynchronously and will be emailed to the requesting user when complete. The response body is empty.
